description: This file contains CSS styles for the Materialize UI framework, including color classes, component styles, utility classes, and normalize.css for cross-browser consistency.

classes.name: container
classes.description: Defines a centered container with max width and responsive widths based on media queries.

classes.name: section
classes.description: Defines section padding and utility classes to adjust padding.

classes.name: row
classes.description: Implements a flexbox/grid system with responsive column sizing, pull, push, and offset classes for different breakpoints.

classes.name: nav
classes.description: Styles the navigation bar, including background, height, link styles, wrapper positioning, and responsive adjustments.

classes.name: card-panel
classes.description: Defines styles for the card panel container with transition, padding, border radius, and background color.

classes.name: card
classes.description: Defines a card component with variable sizes, image handling, content areas, action sections, and reveal overlays.

classes.name: toast-container
classes.description: Container for toast notifications with fixed positioning and responsive size.

classes.name: toast
classes.description: Defines individual toast message styles including layout, color, size, border radius, alignment, and responsive behavior.

classes.name: tabs
classes.description: Styles for tab bar with flex layout, indicator, and individual tab link styles including hover and disabled states.

classes.name: material-tooltip
classes.description: Styles for tooltip elements including padding, font size, background color, border radius, and positioning.

classes.name: backdrop
classes.description: Style for backdrop overlay with position, size, opacity, color, and transformation origins.

classes.name: backdrop
classes.description: Styles the overlay backdrop, used for modals and similar overlays, with position, size, opacity, background color, z-index, and transform origin.

classes.name: btn
classes.description: Styles for general button elements, including disabled, floating, large, flat, block, and color variants with transitions and hover effects.

classes.name: dropdown-content
classes.description: Styles for dropdown menu container, with background, positioning, size, overflow, and list item styles including hover and active states.

classes.name: waves-effect
classes.description: Styles for ripple effects on interactive elements, including ripple circle, transition effects, and variants for different colors.

classes.name: modal
classes.description: Styles for modal dialogs with overlay, positioning, size, responsiveness, header, footer, close buttons, and focus states.

classes.name: lean-overlay
classes.description: Overlay used with modals and dialogs for dimming background.

classes.name: collapsible
classes.description: Styles for collapsible panels, headers, bodies, including variants like popout.

classes.name: chip
classes.description: Styles for chip components, including image avatars, labels, icons, and close icons.

classes.name: materialboxed
classes.description: Styles for image zooming effect using materialboxed class, overlay, caption, and interaction states.

classes.name: select-wrapper
classes.description: Styles for select input wrappers, labels, and the dropdown list, including disabled and optgroup states.

classes.name: file-field
classes.description: Styles for custom file upload input, including button, placeholder, and wrapper.

classes.name: range-field
classes.description: Styles for range sliders, including the track, thumb, and value display, with focus and hover states.

classes.name: slider
classes.description: Styles for image/content sliders, including container, slide items, indicators, and caption overlays.

classes.name: picker
classes.description: Styles for date/time picker components, including overlays, frames, headers, navigation, calendar, day highlighting, footer buttons, and responsiveness.

classes.name: preloader-wrapper
classes.description: Styles for loading spinners with sizes, animation, and color variants.

classes.name: spinner-layer
classes.description: Styles for individual spinner layers, with color variants and animations.

classes.name: tabs
classes.description: Styles for tab navigation, indicator, tab links, including hover, active, and disabled states.

classes.name: tooltips
classes.description: Styles for tooltip popups with padding, background, border-radius, font-size, positioning, and arrow indicators.

classes.name: backdrop
classes.description: Additional overlay styles for dialog and modal backdrops.
